label: Self-giving must instantiate efficient self-causation in respect esse
paraphrase: OPEN analyst cross-sense causal bridge: if in history v the same bearer c exercises strict time-indexed GivesAt v c c t toward its OWN being at t, this qualifies as efficient self-causation of c in the selected esse respect under the separately supplied EfficientlyCausesIn relation. This bridge connects two different causal senses only on the self-edge. INDEX COLLAPSE: the antecedent is indexed to a history v (any history of the frame, not only accessible ones) and a moment t, while EfficientlyCausesIn has neither index; so EfficientlyCausesIn is read here world- and time-neutrally (c is, in some history at some moment, an efficient cause of x's being r), not on the here-and-now gloss of definition 69c0b23e, under which self-giving in a merely possible history would become an actual present efficient self-cause. It does not identify the frame's CausesIn perfection-causation relation with efficient causes, require a physical temporal interval, or claim any real self-giving is possible. It is separate from the existing efficient-esse bridge DistinctActualEsseCauseIsEfficient (definition 8934912c), which passes from CausesIn to the tenseless EfficientlyCausesEsse only for causes distinct from their effect and so cannot cover the self-edge.
